comments.author: randomjackass
comments.html: Reminds me of why I don’t do mushrooms or smoke weed anymore. Great comic, already can’t wait until the next one.

comments.author: Michal
comments.html: Wo-hoo! A brace of updates! I love you man! Keep it going!

comments.author: David
comments.html: I love Sheriff Chuck’s expression, along with everything else about him.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: My brother insists I am Sheriff Chuck (I suppose he fancies himself the protagonist). I don’t think I’m that goofy tho.

comments.author: AJ
comments.html: I think the idea is that sheriff chuck doesnt think hes goofy either though

comments.author: Josh
comments.html: Hey, I wanted to say that this is a great comic arc. And, just to make sure, that was David Foster Wallace (or a DFW-based character) toward the beginning of the arc for two strips or so right?

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: Thanks Josh! Yes that was DFW (or a DFW-character; whichever the reader prefers). When I made those pages I thought he’d be around forever. I’m planning on bringing him back later in the story. Any world I have control over has DFW in it.
